title: Fieldable model-fit probe and commercial signal vignettes
creator: Aisha Rao
description:
Goal: Produce a compact, repeatable probe (a.k.a. "fieldable vignette") that combines competitive signals, model-behavior metrics, and buyer-facing cost/latency heuristics to help Sales and Sourcing teams prioritize model onboarding and fallback contracts.

Scope:
- Define a minimal signal taxonomy (availability, quant-compat, latency tail, hallucination surface, cost-per-1000 tokens, embedding drift) with measurement methods.
- Build a lightweight ingest pipeline for weekly model-catalog snapshots (public releases, partner feeds, and internal benchmarks).
- Prototype a scoring rubric and 3 example vignettes for representative enterprise buyers (FinServ RAG, SMB support assistant, Vector-search analytics).
- Deliver a dashboard spec and a CSV export suitable for procurement trigger rules.

Out-of-scope: full automation of procurement flows, long-term ML model retraining for score calibration.

Acceptance criteria:
1) Taxonomy doc reviewed and approved by PM lead and Research (Aisha + Dr. Lin)
2) Script that pulls and normalizes 3 upstream sources into a weekly snapshot (repo + README)
3) Scoring rubric implemented in a reproducible notebook and tested on 10 candidate models
4) 3 vignettes documented with buyer-facing language and one recommended fallback action each
5) Dashboard wireframe attached and CSV export defined

Success metrics (first 90 days):
- Procurement team uses the CSV in at least 2 RFPs or vendor conversations
- Sales reports the vignette artifacts reduced decision time by >20% in pilot conversations
- Internal adoption: 2+ teams reference the dashboard spec in planning docs
